name: smwgraphics-tiny-overworld-tiles
title: Tiny Overworld Tiles
description:
This is a collection of small overworld tiles that I drew with Segment for fun. We're not going to use it, so I thought I'd submit it.

All of the tiles use vanilla colors. (including the tiny version of the big forest of illusion tree, which needs the forest of illusion colors)

Other than the tree, it's pretty self-explanatory... tiny stuff...
